name: BACH_0061
markdown:
## Bottom line
**Suggests Benign (99%)** · Confident · Careful review
Single-class conformal set and clean quality, but cell measurements look tumor-like [F1].

## Confidence
| Signal | Value | Reading |
|---|---|---|
| Top probabilities | Benign 99%, InSitu 1% | Clear leader |
| Conformal set | {Benign} at 90% | Single class |
| Reliability / OOD | 0.999 / 100th percentile | Not flagged |
| Second-model (MUSK) agreement | Same top class | Agrees |
| Similar cases | 3 of 5 Benign | Moderate; 2 InSitu |

## Tissue evidence
- **Tumor infiltrating stroma** (region 3) · ↓ invasive · Below typical; lowers invasive association · Validated
- **Atypical cells confined within ducts** (regions 0, 4, 11) · ↓ invasive · Above typical; points toward non-invasive disease · Weak
- **Tumor cell fraction** (regions 1, 3, 7) · context · 94% neoplastic nuclei, 100th reference percentile [F7] · Measured
- **Normal lobules, two-layered epithelium** (region 0) · ↑ invasive · Below typical; term favors invasive, failed spot check · Unreliable

## Trust check
- **Heatmap**: Removing the top 3 regions drops the invasive logit 0.54 more than random (CI 0.47–0.60); faithful to the classifier.
- **Concepts**: Deletion CI (−0.005 to 0.007) includes 0: not shown to reflect the classifier. Normal lobules (0/20) is Unreliable, yet carries the largest term.

## Could be wrong if
- Tumor-like nuclei in regions 1, 3, 7 reflect carcinoma; only 3 regions were measured.
- The two InSitu neighbors are the better match; neighbor agreement is only 3 of 5.

## Check on the slide
1. **Regions 1, 3, 7:** Confirm whether the dense neoplastic nuclei are benign or carcinoma.
2. **Regions 0, 4, 11:** Check whether atypical cells stay confined within ducts.
3. **Region 3:** Look for stromal invasion; its score was below typical.
